faultLoc.explanation: The method is attempting to call `stream()` on a potentially null object. This leads to a NullPointerException when the input is null. The method should handle null inputs by returning an empty stream instead of trying to call methods on a null object.
There should be a null check before attempting to call any methods on the stream object. If the stream is null, the method should return an empty stream to avoid NullPointerException.
